initial_state.name: no initial stock

process_behavior.meaning: The courier transports shipments from the blood centre to the hospital. A shipment takes about 3 hours to reach the hospital and be received into its bank.
process_behavior.operating_meaning: The courier operates on Tuesday and Thursday after 4:00 PM dispatch, completing delivery by about 7:00 PM the same day.
process_behavior.rate_meaning: Not applicable; the courier does not have a rate, it delivers fixed-size shipments.

process_behavior.meaning: The mobile collection drive collects blood at the Portland site. It operates Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM America/Los_Angeles. The collection week is Monday 20 July to Friday 24 July 2026.
process_behavior.operating_meaning: The drive is open Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM America/Los_Angeles.
process_behavior.rate_meaning: The drive collects at a measured average of 12 usable units per hour while it is open.
